socket.description: Socket address for communication with MTA (e.g., Postfix). Uses RUNDIR which defaults to /run/opendkim. Use 'local:path' for Unix domain sockets, 'inet:port@host' for TCP.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file. In legacy script uses $RUNDIR/$NAME.pid.

run_dir.description: Runtime directory for socket, PID file, and temp files (used in legacy script only).
